label: Si SWG double-periodicity Bragg pump-rejection filter, dW 5 nm, LF 1000 um (TE)
core_material: Si 220 nm on 2 um bottom oxide (SOI), single etch step (EBL 80 kV, 5 nm step size; ICP SF6 etch)
cladding: PMMA protective cover above; 2 um bottom oxide
notes: Sub-wavelength engineered double-periodicity Bragg filter: Bragg cell of two rectangularly corrugated sub-cells, LN = LW = 85 nm (sub-wavelength period 170 nm, Bragg period 340 nm); central strip WC = 300 nm, corrugation widths W1 = W + dW and W2 = W with W = 150 nm (p.2 Fig. 2, p.3); corrugation width and the 170 nm sub-period have no registry parameter on reflector (report). 3.4 um long ten-period adiabatic transition between strip waveguide and filter, minimum corrugation width 50 nm (p.3, Fig. 1(a)). Measured in transmission through SWG grating couplers and cleaved SMF-28 fibers, TE (p.4). Fab: first-person fabrication sentence (p.3-4), authors at C2N (CNRS / Univ. Paris-Sud / Paris-Saclay) and Institut de Physique de Nice; site not named, fab left empty (two orgs; yasui2026 precedent). Off-band transmission equals the 1000 um, 450 nm wide reference strip waveguide within the alignment precision (p.4, no number). Headline device (abstract, p.4).

label: Si3N4 40 nm ultra-high-Q bus-coupled ring, R 11.787 mm, with redeposited SiN boundary layer (DUT)
core_material: Si3N4 40 nm core, 11 um wide; bus 7 um x 40 nm; weakly tapered bus-ring coupler; few tens of nm LPCVD SiN redeposited after etch + heat treatment (boundary layer)
cladding: 15 um thermal SiO2 lower cladding; 6 um TEOS-LPCVD SiO2 upper cladding; anneal 1100 C 9 h
notes: DUT wafer with the redeposition-and-anneal step (p.5). Not entered: absorption-limited Q 3.4 billion and 51 kHz absorption-limited linewidth at 1600 nm (photothermal, p.8 Fig. 2(e); no registry parameter, report); ring-down times 181 ns at 1570 nm (Fig. 2(b)) and 149 ns at 1550 nm (p.17 Supp. Fig. S4(f)); splitting rates of 96 resonances near 1550 nm on three devices (Fig. 3(c), scatter plot); fitted effective top roughness 0.24 nm; scattering-model estimates (assumed roughness). Fab org_honeywell, borderline (D84b): the acknowledgment thanks Honeywell staff for mask design and sample fabrication, and the Honeywell first author conceived the design and fabrication process (p.10). arXiv text (page-1 title adds '3.4 Billion Absorption Limited Q'); same work as the source row by arXiv id; journal version not read. Coupling regime: the Lorentzian fit does not separate intrinsic from coupling rate; the split comes from a COMSOL coupling simulation fitted to the extracted rates, checked against a direct measurement on a coupling test structure (p.16 Supp. Fig. S3). At 1570 nm the resonance is critically coupled (Q_in = 2 Q_L, dip to about zero, Fig. 2(a)), so the 1570 nm intrinsic values do not depend on that assignment (measured / derived, D418 ye2019 precedent); at 1550 nm the DUT is under-coupled (Q_in / Q_L = 1.33, Supp. Fig. S4(c)) and those q_intrinsic rows stay author_estimate (D403). Over-etch about 100 nm into the lower cladding seen in SEM (p.5). Simulated critical bend radius about 6.8 mm (p.15) not entered.
